text: What is the role of 'shapes' (such as Δⁿ, ∂Δⁿ, Λⁿₖ) in Simplicial TT?
choices: They are types in the universe
They are geometric objects parametrising the extension types that express Segal/Kan conditions
explanation: Shapes parametrise extension types: {A | Λ²₁ ↦ (f,g)} expresses composability conditions.
